page_title: GEN 0-3 LAZ | Genoa v Lazio 29/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+5' Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Ivan Provedel!
90+4' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90+3' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' It looks like Leo Ostigard (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Giovanni Ayroldi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
86' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
84' Kristian Wilson prepares a substitution. Aaron Martin is replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa).
84' A substitution has been made. Toma Basic (Lazio) goes off and Pedro comes on.
84' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Patric replaces Mario Gila (Lazio).
84' Here is a change. Taty Castellanos is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio).
81' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.
81' Genoa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
81' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
75' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
74' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
73' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
72' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
70' Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
69' The substitution has been made. Nuno Tavares (Lazio) has replaced Luca Pellegrini.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Colombo departs the field of play to be replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
69' Here comes a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Ruslan Malinovskyi.
68' Kristian Wilson has decided to substitute Patrizio Masini and he is replaced by Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa).
68' Kristian Wilson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Valentin Carboni replacing Vitinha (Genoa).
67' Giovanni Ayroldi sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
64' The Lazio players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
63' 0 - 3 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:3.

63' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.

63' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but Nicola Leali keeps it out.
62' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' The Genoa players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Giovanni Ayroldi. NO PENALTY!
58' There's a break in play and referee Giovanni Ayroldi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Genoa using VAR. This could be interesting!
57' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio). It's a penalty to Genoa! Let's see who's going to take it.
57' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

56' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
55' Vitinha (Genoa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
55' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
53' Aaron Martin (Genoa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Lazio will take a free kick.
53' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicola Leali intercepts the ball.
51' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
51' Giovanni Ayroldi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Morten Frendrup (Genoa) and blew his whistle.
49' Vitinha (Genoa) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
47' The game is interrupted. Mario Gila (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The whistle blows and Giovanni Ayroldi starts the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) who directs his shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to stop his effort.
44' Genoa take a short corner kick.

44' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
44' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
41' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
39' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Giovanni Ayroldi saw the whole situation.
38' Aaron Martin (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
37' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes a mid-range free kick, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
36' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
32' Problems for Maurizio Sarri as Adam Marusic is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) replaces him.
30' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' 0 - 2 Goal! Adam Marusic produces a great pass that finds Taty Castellanos (Lazio) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
29' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
28' The ball is cleared after Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) makes a strong challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
24' What a big chance! Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
23' Vitinha (Genoa) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
22' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Aaron Martin (Genoa), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
21' Adam Marusic (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
20' Vitinha (Genoa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
18' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
17' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
16' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
14' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' 56:44 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
12' Rough tackle by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Neat passing move from Genoa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giovanni Ayroldi no option but to blow his whistle.
4' 0 - 1 Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the left side of the goal.
3' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
2' Flag goes up against Taty Castellanos (Lazio) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
1' The first half has just begun.
Genoa will kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
